# REST API Error Handling Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Others > REST API

## Overview

Implements API error handling with proper HTTP status codes, error response formats, and problem details following RFC 7807

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [rest-api-error-handling-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
rest-api-error-handling-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@rest-api-error-handling-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design error responses following RFC 7807
- Use proper HTTP status codes for error types
- Implement validation error response formatting
- Configure global error handling middleware

## Technology Standards Applied

- **RFC 7807**: Problem Details for HTTP APIs
- **HTTP Status Codes**: Proper status code usage
- **Error Documentation**: Error catalog and documentation
